description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Divine Communion Mode], Oracle's Duty +1 and God Conversation +1 to the user

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Divine Communion Mode
description.text: Grants [Oracle's Decree Summoning +15% Boost]/[Oracle's Decree Summoning +30% Boost]/[Oracle's Decree Summoning +50% Boost] after using 1/2/3+ of Hydraean's Mercy or Oath of Covenant, grants [Damage Cap +10000 3] and causes God Conversation -1 if the character has God Conversation level 1 after using three of Hydraean's Mercy or Ceremonial Pledge
